<a id="playtest"></a>

## PLAYTEST

Source: [arc_help.ini](../../CoffeeMud/resources/help/arc_help.ini), line 2245.

```text
Command  : PLAYTEST
Usage    : PLAYTEST ON (PARTY=name,name) (DIFFICULTY=preset) (KIT=name)
Usage    : PLAYTEST OFF / GAME / RUN [FILE]
Usage    : PARTY MORTAL [NAME] / PARTY ARCHON [NAME]
Usage    : BUILD [COMMAND]
Example  : playtest on
Example  : build modify mob sentry
Short(s) :
In builder mode, meets the world as a mortal would.  While on, every sysop power you have is
 suspended: aggressive mobs attack you, followers follow, dopplegangers scale to you and
spawns spawn as for a player, and the prompt says (playtest).  A death takes you back,
whole, to the room you began the playtest in.  BUILD runs one command with your powers back
(an editor that asks for input after the command returns may refuse); it is a command only
in a playtest, where the Building skill is BUILDING, and is the skill otherwise.  PLAYTEST
OFF ends it, makes you whole and makes peace. ON/OFF keeps inventory, XP and world changes.
PLAYTEST GAME snapshots the current world and party into a disposable campaign in another
process/window; close it to discard changes. With no display it prints a command to run in
another terminal and the temporary folder to remove. The original builder world stays open.
ON accepts profile companions, a difficulty preset and a kit; the party tests as mortals,
and OFF restores their powers. PARTY MORTAL or ARCHON changes one active party member in
builder mode. PLAYTEST RUN [FILE] and WORLD TEST ([FILE]) run .play, .test and JavaScript
tests from world/tests in disposable campaigns and report PASS or FAIL here. GOD (in a DEV=1
 game or builder mode) turns single powers and cheats on and off instead.
```

<a id="preview"></a>

## PREVIEW

Source: [arc_help.ini](../../CoffeeMud/resources/help/arc_help.ini), line 2333.

```text
Command  : PREVIEW
Usage    : PREVIEW (ROOM) ([CONDITION]...)
Usage    : CHECKTEXT (ROOM/AREA/WORLD)
Example  : preview night winter snow
Example  : preview from north visited
Example  : preview dusk as Bob var BRIDGE=1
Example  : checktext area
Short(s) : CHECKTEXT
PREVIEW shows this room's title and description as they read under the conditions given, the
 rest as they are, and changes nothing: a time of day (DAY, NIGHT, DAWN, DUSK), a season
(SPRING, SUMMER, FALL, WINTER), a weather (RAIN, SNOW, CLEAR, FOG, THUNDERSTORM, BLIZZARD,
WINDY, CLOUDY...), FROM a direction or FROM UNKNOWN, VISITED or FIRSTVISIT, AS a character
(for MASK parts and what they are doing) and VAR NAME=VALUE (a script variable of the
reader, put back after).  Only rooms' texts vary (<VARIES>).  CHECKTEXT lists what in rooms'
 titles and descriptions would print as text instead of varying: variation tags in a text
that does not start with <VARIES>, tags that are none (<nigth>), tags in small letters
(their end is found only in capitals), tags opened and not closed or closed and not opened,
a MASK whose mask has a > in it (write &gt;), and a colour code left open at the end.
<FROMUNKNOWN> is the same as <FROMUNKOWN>, as the code long spelled it.
```

<a id="pricecheck"></a>

## PRICECHECK

Source: [arc_help.ini](../../CoffeeMud/resources/help/arc_help.ini), line 2225.

```text
Command  : PRICECHECK
Usage    : PRICECHECK [ITEM] (AT [SHOPKEEPER]) (FOR [CHARACTER]) (SELL)
Example  : pricecheck cloak
Example  : pricecheck sword at smith for Bob sell
Short(s) :
In builder mode, a DEV=1 game or with CMDMOBS: how a shop's price for something was reached.
  It lists the settings the shop prices by (PREJUDICE, PRICEMASKS, BUDGET, DEVALRATE,
INVRESETRATE and IGNOREMASK) with where each came from: the shopkeeper, its area, a parent
area or the ini, and a running quest that gave it.  Then each step of the sum, as the shop
works it out: the base price, the prejudice rule that matched, each price mask that matched,
 charisma against the keeper's wisdom, sales tax, the fall for what is in stock, and the
rounding to coins.  Last, both prices, the budget left and when the stock is next put back.
  Without SELL it is what the shop asks; with SELL, what it pays.  The item is looked for in
 the shop's stock, then the character's and your own inventory, then the room.  With no AT,
the first shopkeeper here that is not a player; with no FOR, yourself.
```

<a id="prop-absorbdamage"></a>

## PROP_ABSORBDAMAGE

Source: [arc_properties.ini](../../CoffeeMud/resources/help/arc_properties.ini), line 294.

```text
Property   : Prop_AbsorbDamage
Targets    : Items, Mobs, Areas, Rooms
Parameters : Damage Absorption percentages or amounts, the list of absorbed damage types
Example    : 50% +ALL -SILVER -CLOTH -LEATHER
Example    : 5 +ALL -MAGIC -SLASHING -FROSTING
Example    : 25% +ALL -LEVEL15
Example    : 15% +BASHING 1 +IRON 3 +STEEL 15% +MAGIC
Example    : 40% +BURNING SOURCEMASK="-RACECAT +Dragon"
CoffeeSUD: SOURCEMASK="[ZAPPER MASK]" makes it work only against the attackers it fits.
Description:
Whenever the item with this property is worn, or for the mob with this property, or anyone
in the area or room with this property, they will attain damage absorption from the types
and/or materials of weapons specified.  Damage absorption may be represented as a percentage
 or as a straight amount. Damage amounts must be before the type of damage absorbed in the
parameters. Damage amounts/percentages in the negative will add to the damage. If the term
"ENHANCED" is included in the parameters, and percentage absorption amounts are used, then
this will also attempt to auto-save against skills according to the percentage change, or,
if the percentage is negative, make the effect last longer. Here are the parameters:
+ALL - Specifies that, by default, the mob has ALL damage absorbed.
-[DAMAGETYPE]- Creates an exception to the +ALL rule by permitting normal damage of the
given type.  Examples for DAMAGETYPE would be -PIERCING, -GASSING, -SLASHING, -BURNING,
-MELTING, -NATURAL, -BASHING, etc.
+[DAMAGETYPE]- Can be used instead of +ALL to absorb damage from the given damage type.
Examples for DAMAGETYPE would be +PIERCING, +GASSING, +SLASHING, +BURNING, +MELTING,
+NATURAL, +BASHING, etc.
-[WEAPONCLASS]- Creates an exception to the +ALL rule by permitting normal damage of the
given class.  Examples for WEAPONCLASS would be -AXE, -BLUNT, -EDGED, -FLAILED, -HAMMER,
-KARATE, -POLEARM, -RANGED, -SWORD, -DAGGER, -STAFF, -THROWN, etc.
-[WEAPONCLASS]- Can be used instead of +ALL to absorb damage from the given weapon class.
Examples for WEAPONCLASS would be +AXE, +BLUNT, +EDGED, +FLAILED, +HAMMER, +KARATE,
+POLEARM, +RANGED, +SWORD, +DAGGER, +STAFF, +THROWN, etc.
-[ABILITYCODE]- Creates an exception to the +ALL rule by permitting normal damage of the
given type of ability.  Examples for ABILITYCODE would be -THIEF_SKILL, -PRAYER, etc.  Do
list abilitycodes.
+[ABILITYCODE]- Can be used instead of +ALL to absorb damage from the given type of ability.
  Examples for ABILITYCODE be +SPELL, +SONG, etc.. Do list abilitycodes.
-[ABILITYDOMAIN]- Creates an exception to the +ALL rule by permitting normal damage of the
given domain of ability.  Examples for ABILITYDOMAIN would be -ILLUSION, -DEATH_LORE, etc.
Do list abilitydomains.
+[ABILITYDOMAIN]- Can be used instead of +ALL to absorb damage from the given domain of
ability.  Examples for ABILITYDOMAIN be +SPELL, +SONG, etc.. Do list abilitydomains.
-[ABILITYFLAG]- Creates an exception to the +ALL rule by permitting normal damage of the
given flagged abilities.  Examples for ABILITYFLAG would be -UNHOLY, -CHARMING, etc. Do list
 abilityflags.
+[ABILITYFLAG]- Can be used instead of +ALL to absorb damage from the given flagged
abilities.  Examples for ABILITYDOMAIN be +HOLY, +CHARMING, etc..  Do list abilityflags.
-[ABILITYID]- Creates an exception to the +ALL rule by permitting normal damage of the given
 specific ability.  Examples for ABILITYID would be -SPELL_FIREBALL, etc.
+[ABILITYID]- Can be used instead of +ALL to absorb damage from the given specific ability.
  Examples for ABILITYID be +SPELL_MAGICMISSILE, etc..
-MAGIC - Creates an exception to the +ALL rule by permitting normal damage from magical
spells and magical weapons.
+MAGIC - If +ALL is not used, this will absorb damage from magical spells and weapons.
-LEVELX - Creates an exception to the +ALL rule by permitting normal damage from weapons
whose level is X or better. Example: -LEVEL1, -LEVEL5, -LEVEL10, etc.
+LEVELX - Can be used instead of +ALL to absorb damage from weapons whose level is X or
lower. Example: +LEVEL1, +LEVEL5, +LEVEL10, etc.
-MATERIALTYPE - Creates an exception to the +ALL rule above by permitting normal damage from
 a weapon made of the given MATERIALTYPE.  Where MATERIALTYPE may be any valid material,
such as SILVER, WOOD, COTTON, etc.  As for the damage types above, +MATERIALTYPE may be used
 instead of +ALL to absorb damage from materials a given material.
-PARALYSIS - Creates an exception to the +All rule by permitting normal damage from
paralysis spells.
+PARALYSIS - If +All is not used, this absorbs damage from damage from fire spells.
-FIRE - Creates an exception to the +All rule by permitting normal damage from fire spells.
+FIRE - If +All is not used, this absorbs damage from damage from fire spells.
-COLD - Creates an exception to the +All rule by permitting normal damage from cold spells.
+COLD - If +All is not used, this absorbs damage from damage from cold spells.
-WATER - Creates an exception to the +All rule by permitting normal damage from water
spells.
+WATER - If +All is not used, this absorbs damage from damage from water spells.
-GAS - Creates an exception to the +All rule by permitting normal damage from gas spells.
+GAS - If +All is not used, this absorbs damage from damage from gas spells.
-MIND - Creates an exception to the +All rule by permitting normal damage from mind spells.
+MIND - If +All is not used, this absorbs damage from damage from mind spells.
-JUSTICE - Creates an exception to the +All rule by permitting normal damage from justice
spells.
+JUSTICE - If +All is not used, this absorbs damage from damage from justice spells.
-ACID - Creates an exception to the +All rule by permitting normal damage from acid spells.
+ACID - If +All is not used, this absorbs damage from damage from acid spells.
-ELECTRICITY - Creates an exception to the +All rule by permitting normal damage from
electric spells.
+ELECTRICITY - If +All is not used, this absorbs damage from damage from electric spells.
-POISON - Creates an exception to the +All rule by permitting normal damage from poison
spells.
+POISON - If +All is not used, this absorbs damage from damage from poison spells.
-UNDEAD - Creates an exception to the +All rule by permitting normal damage from undead
spells.
+UNDEAD - If +All is not used, this absorbs damage from damage from undead/evil spells.
-DISEASE - Creates an exception to the +All rule by permitting normal damage from disease
spells.
+DISEASE - If +All is not used, this absorbs damage from damage from disease spells.
-TRAPS - Creates an exception to the +All rule by permitting normal damage from traps
spells.
```

<a id="prop-adddamage"></a>

## PROP_ADDDAMAGE

Source: [arc_properties.ini](../../CoffeeMud/resources/help/arc_properties.ini), line 384.

```text
Property   : Prop_AddDamage
Targets    : Items, Mobs
Parameters : Extra Damage percentages or amounts, the list of extra damage types
Example    : 50% PIERCING
Example    : 5 SLASHING FROST
Example    : 50% BURNING FIRE TARGETMASK="-RACECAT +Undead"
Example    : 5 LEECH=25%
Description:
Whenever the item with this property is worn, or for the mob with this property, they will
do extra damage of the types specified.  Extra Damage may be represented as a percentage or
as a straight amount. Damage amounts must be before the type of extra damage in the
parameters. * Here are the classes of damage:
NATURAL, SLASHING, PIERCING, BASHING, BURNING, BURSTING, SHOOTING, FROSTING, GASSING,
MELTING, STRIKING, LASERING, SONICING, DISRUPTING, STULTIFYING, CORRUPTING, SCRAPING
* Here are the types of damage attacks:
PARALYSIS, FIRE, COLD, WATER, GAS, MIND, JUSTICE, ACID, ELECTRICITY, POISON, UNDEAD,
DISEASE, TRAPS, WEAPONATTACK.
* CoffeeSUD: TARGETMASK="[ZAPPER MASK]" gives the extra damage only to the victims it fits
(a bane weapon), and LEECH=[N]% heals the wielder that share of the damage dealt, the hit
and the extra.
ALLSET="set-name-N" activates this bonus when at least N worn pieces share the set name,
including pieces using the other ALLSET bonus properties. Each property keeps its own
threshold; the default is two pieces.
```

<a id="prop-affinity"></a>

## PROP_AFFINITY

Source: [arc_properties.ini](../../CoffeeMud/resources/help/arc_properties.ini), line 505.

```text
Property   : Prop_Affinity
Targets    : MOBs, Areas
Parameters : (START=[N]) (DECAY=[N]) (GIFT([ITEM])=[+N]) (TALK([WORD])=[+N])
(QUESTWIN([QUEST])=[+N]) (ATTACKED=[-N]) (STOLE=[-N]) (KILLED([MOB])=[-N]) (BRIBE=[N])
(SHOPFACTOR=[BAND]:[N],...) (REFUSE=[BAND]) (REFUSEMSG="[TEXT]")
Example    : GIFT(rare ore)=+10 QUESTWIN(The Smith's Blade)=+30 ATTACKED=-40
SHOPFACTOR=FRIENDLY:0.9,DEVOTED:0.8 REFUSE=HOSTILE
Description:
CoffeeSUD: the NPC's opinion of each character, a number from START (0): HOSTILE below -50,
COLD below 0, NEUTRAL, FRIENDLY from 25, DEVOTED from 75.  It moves by the rules: an item
given that GIFT's item names (words of its name, or a +/- mask), money given (BRIBE points a
 gold), a word said to it (TALK, at most once a game day each), a quest won (QUESTWIN,
counted when next read), an attack on it (ATTACKED, once a game hour), a theft from it
(STOLE), or a killing it sees of a mob KILLED names.  DECAY brings it that much toward 0 a
game day.  SHOPFACTOR multiplies its prices by band (a friend sells for less and pays more);
 REFUSE: at or below that band it will not trade, saying REFUSEMSG.  On an area, it is the
village's opinion, shared by its NPCs that have none of their own.  It is kept in the game's
 script variables AFFINITY_[CHARACTER] of the NPC (or the area), so a save keeps it; it does
 not show in FACTIONS.  Scripts read AFFINITY($i $n) (or AFFINITY($i $n BAND)) and change it
 with MPAFFINITY; Prop_NPCLines takes [AFFINITY >=25] or [AFFINITY FRIENDLY] after an entry;
 MudChat a ?AFFINITY($i $t > 25) guard.
```

<a id="prop-ambush"></a>

## PROP_AMBUSH

Source: [arc_properties.ini](../../CoffeeMud/resources/help/arc_properties.ini), line 525.

```text
Property   : Prop_Ambush
Targets    : Rooms
Parameters : MOBS="[MOBS]" (CHANCE=[N]) (DETECT=[STAT]+[SKILL]:[N]) (SURPRISE=[N])
(MSG="[TEXT]") (SPOTMSG="[TEXT]") (WAIT=[N]) (RESET=[N]) (MASK="[ZAPPER MASK]")
Example    : MOBS="encounter:bandits" DETECT=WIS+Thief_DetectTraps:15 MSG="Figures burst
from the undergrowth!" SPOTMSG="You spot glints of steel in the bushes."
Example    : MOBS="catalog:a bandit*3" CHANCE=50 RESET=300 MASK="-LEVEL +>4"
Description:
CoffeeSUD: an ambush.  When the party walks in (its leader, at CHANCE percent, 100, if MASK
fits), MOBS come out: name*dice joined with + (catalog: optional) or encounter:[TABLE].  The
 party's best rolls DETECT: d20, a stat's (N-10)/2 and a skill's proficiency/10, against the
 number (15).  Not spotted: MSG shows, the ambushers strike, and the party is caught by
surprise for SURPRISE rounds (1; Prop_Surprised), unable to move or strike.  Spotted: the
party sees SPOTMSG and may strike first or walk on (the ambushers go) before WAIT ticks (2)
are up, when they attack.  It springs once, or again RESET ticks later.  AMBUSH_PROG
SURPRISED, SPOTTED or AVOIDED runs on the room's scripts and its NPCs'.
```

<a id="prop-areaforsale"></a>

## PROP_AREAFORSALE

Source: [arc_properties.ini](../../CoffeeMud/resources/help/arc_properties.ini), line 541.

```text
Property   : Prop_AreaForSale
Targets    : Areas
Parameters : (RENTAL )Price of the area
Example    : 1000000
Example    : Bob/100000
Description:
Makes this area available for purchase by a player.  To have a shopkeeper sell the area, you
 must create a GenTitle or StdTitle item with the area name as the property id and give it
to the shopkeeper to sell.  The system will automatically maintain the integrity of any
items left in the rooms, including restoring them on reboot. The title received for
purchasing a room may be GIVEn or SELLed to change possession of the property.  The word
rental followed by a space may preceed the price to make the price of the property be
charged every month automatically out of a Bankers account.  Failure to make rent returns
the property to sellable status.

When property is sold, it will be listed as the owner with a slash and the price.  Entering
this sort of parameter directly is the quick way to give players or clans property.

See also Prop_ReqCapacity for the means to set limits on players building abilities on their
 property.
```

<a id="prop-attunement"></a>

## PROP_ATTUNEMENT

Source: [arc_properties.ini](../../CoffeeMud/resources/help/arc_properties.ini), line 410.

```text
Property   : Prop_Attunement
Targets    : Items
Parameters : PROPS="[ID]([ARGS]);[ID]([ARGS])" (HOW=REST:[TICKS]) (RITUAL="INROOM [ROOM ID]
& SAY [WORDS]") (ON=EQUIP) (LIMIT=[N]) (BIND=true) (MSG="[TEXT]") (MASK="[ZAPPER MASK]")
Example    : PROPS="Prop_WearEnabler(Spell_Haste);Prop_WearAdjuster(dex+2)" HOW=REST:10
LIMIT=3 BIND=true
Example    : PROPS="Prop_WearEnabler(Chant_Barkskin)" RITUAL="INROOM Grove#1 & SAY attune"
Description:
CoffeeSUD: powers that wake only once the item is attuned.  PROPS stay inert until then.
One attunes by resting with it (HOW=REST:[TICKS], sitting or sleeping while carrying it), by
 a RITUAL (in the room, saying the words; either part may be left out), or by wearing it
(ON=EQUIP).  LIMIT is how many items a character may be attuned to (3); UNATTUNE [ITEM]
frees one.  BIND keeps it inert in anyone else's hands.  MSG is what the one who attunes is
told; MASK is who may.  Identifying it says it requires attunement, or to whom it is
attuned.
```

<a id="prop-autosave"></a>

## PROP_AUTOSAVE

Source: [arc_properties.ini](../../CoffeeMud/resources/help/arc_properties.ini), line 424.

```text
Property   : Prop_AutoSave
Targets    : Rooms, Areas
Parameters : (ONCE=CHAR) (SLOT=[NAME]) (ROTATE=[NUMBER]) (MSG="[MESSAGE]")
Example    : ONCE=CHAR MSG="[Autosaved]"
Example    : SLOT=auto ROTATE=3
Description:
Saves the game when the player comes into the room, or into the area from outside it.  With
ONCE=CHAR, only the first time each character comes in. The save is called SLOT (auto if not
 given); with ROTATE, the saves take turns, SLOT1 to SLOT3 for ROTATE=3, so the last three
are kept.  The player is told MSG, or [Autosaved].  It is skipped while the party fights
(unless the save mode is ANYWHERE), but saves even where Prop_NoSave or the lack of a save
point would refuse a SAVE.  In an ironman game it writes the game's one save.
```

<a id="prop-blockedexit"></a>

## PROP_BLOCKEDEXIT

Source: [arc_properties.ini](../../CoffeeMud/resources/help/arc_properties.ini), line 589.

```text
Property   : Prop_BlockedExit
Targets    : Exits
Parameters : (NAME="[TEXT]") (HP=[N]) (TOOL="[ZAPPER MASK]") (SKILL=[STAT]+[SKILL])
(FIRE=true) (MSG="[TEXT]") (CLEARMSG="[TEXT]") (ONCLEAR="[ACTIONS]") (RESPAWN=[TICKS])
Example    : NAME="a pile of rubble" HP=40 TOOL="-TAGS +PICKAXE" SKILL=Digging+STR
CLEARMSG="The rubble gives way to a dark tunnel."
Example    : NAME="a wall of vines" HP=60 FIRE=true RESPAWN=3000
Description:
CoffeeSUD: a blockage the player must clear.  While it stands nobody goes that way, and LOOK
 at the exit says so.  CLEAR, DIG, SMASH, HIT or ATTACK the direction (or the blockage by
its NAME) wears it down: 1d6 and SKILL (a stat's (N-10)/2, a skill's proficiency/10) off its
 HP (40) each try, with TOOL held or wielded if given.  FIRE=true lets BURN clear it at once
 with a lit light in hand.  MSG shows each try; CLEARMSG on both sides when it is gone, and
ONCLEAR's actions run; RESPAWN ticks later it is back (0: never).  What is left of it is
kept with it (LEFT=), and one on the other side of the exit is kept the same.
```

<a id="prop-checkpoint"></a>

## PROP_CHECKPOINT

Source: [arc_properties.ini](../../CoffeeMud/resources/help/arc_properties.ini), line 604.

```text
Property   : Prop_Checkpoint
Targets    : Rooms
Parameters : (NAME="[TEXT]") (ON=ENTER/REST/COMMAND:[WORD]) (HEAL=[N]%) (RESPAWNAREA=true)
(SAVE=AUTO/[SLOT])
Example    : NAME="the Old Shrine" ON=COMMAND:pray HEAL=100% RESPAWNAREA=true
Example    : ON=ENTER SAVE=AUTO
Description:
CoffeeSUD: a checkpoint.  When the party walks in (ON=ENTER, the default), rests there
(REST: sits or sleeps) or types the word (COMMAND:pray), the room becomes the respawn point
of each of the party there: kept on the character, through death, and apart from the recall
room.  With DEATH=CHECKPOINT in coffeemud.ini, a fallen character wakes at their last
checkpoint (or their recall room, with none).  HEAL heals them that share; RESPAWNAREA
brings the area's dead mobs back; SAVE saves the game (AUTO, or a slot's name).  Scripts set
 it with MPSETRESPAWN and read it with RESPAWNROOM().
```

<a id="prop-closecommand"></a>

## PROP_CLOSECOMMAND

Source: [arc_properties.ini](../../CoffeeMud/resources/help/arc_properties.ini), line 635.

```text
Property   : Prop_CloseCommand
Targets    : Containers, Exits
Parameters : [COMMAND WORD] ([PARMS...]/NOCLOSE/MESSAGE=[STR];...
Example    : twist knob;tw knob;twi knob;noclose
Example    : smack botto*
Description:
When applied to an open container or exit, this property will force the affected openable to
 close and maybe lock when the command phrase is entered by the user in its presence.  The
command word must match exactly, and the command entered must otherwise be completely
invalid.  PARMS arguments must also match exactly, although any PARM arg may end with * to
use a starting string wildcard. A PARM argument may also end with ** to match the rest of
the users entered command string. In addition to a series of command words, you can also use
 the NOCLOSE keyword to also disable the standard close command for the exit/item, or use
MESSAGE= to change the message sent to the room, which can use <S-NAME> for the actor, and
<T-NAME> for the item.
```

<a id="prop-closeddaynight"></a>

## PROP_CLOSEDDAYNIGHT

Source: [arc_properties.ini](../../CoffeeMud/resources/help/arc_properties.ini), line 652.

```text
Property   : Prop_ClosedDayNight
Targets    : Items, Mobs, Rooms, Exits
Parameters : (DAY/NIGHT)(SLEEP)(SIT)(LOCKUP)(HOURS=0-13)(HOME=Room#)
Parameters : (WARNMSGx=[msg]) (SHOPMSG=[msg]) (MASK=)
Example    : DAY
Example    : SLEEP HOURS=5-10
Example    : "Home=My Area#123" SLEEP LOCKUP MASK=-RACE +ELF
Example    : "Home=Bob`s House" SLEEP LOCKUP "SHOPMSG=Go Away! I'm Closed!"
Description:
Affects the thing with this property depending on the time of day. By default, this property
 activates at night.  If the DAY paramater is included, it will activate by day instead. The
 effect of the property is that rooms will go dark, exits will close, and items will become
unseeable. Mobs will become unseeable by default, though if the sit or sleep flags are set,
they will do that instead.  LOCKUP will cause the mob to lock up his starting room, if any
doors with locks are found.  If a Home Room is specified with the HOME= parameter, the mob
will track to that room at closing time, then back to their start room the next day.  For
shopkeepers, you can specify a SHOPMSG for them to say whenever someone tries to interact
with them as a shopkeeper during closed hours.  You can also specify a particular greeting
message at a particular hour of the day with WARNMSG, such as WARNMSG0 for the 0th hour of
the day, etc..
```

<a id="prop-combolock"></a>

## PROP_COMBOLOCK

Source: [arc_properties.ini](../../CoffeeMud/resources/help/arc_properties.ini), line 706.

```text
Property   : Prop_ComboLock
Targets    : Exits, Containers
Parameters : CODE=[CODE]/RANDOM (SYMBOLS="[SYMBOL],[SYMBOL]"/[N]-[N]) (DIALS=[N])
(VERB=[VERB]) (SHOW=true) (TRIES=[N]) (ONWRONG="[ACTIONS]") (ONOPEN="[ACTIONS]")
(RELOCK=[TICKS]) (MSG="[TEXT]") (VAR=[NAME])
Example    : CODE=sun-star-moon SYMBOLS="sun,moon,star" SHOW=true TRIES=3 ONWRONG="cast
Spell_ShockingGrasp $n"
Example    : CODE=739 RELOCK=30
Example    : CODE=RANDOM DIALS=4 VAR=VAULTCODE
Description:
CoffeeSUD: a combination lock on a door or a container.  TURN DIAL 2 TO 3 sets one dial
(VERB changes the word), SET DIALS 7 3 9 all of them, ENTER 739 a keypad's code; ON [THING]
picks one when there are more.  SYMBOLS are each dial's (0-9 by default); DIALS how many (as
 many as the code has).  When the dials read the code, it unlocks and opens, on both sides
of a door, with MSG, and runs ONOPEN; RELOCK shuts and locks it again after that many ticks.
  SHOW adds what the dials read to LOOK.  After TRIES wrong codes, ONWRONG runs.
CODE=RANDOM rolls one for each new game (DIALS of the SYMBOLS), kept with the lock, and VAR
puts it in the script variable $<COMBO [NAME]> for a clue to print.  Actions are script
commands, as in Prop_Switch.
```

<a id="prop-craftxp"></a>

## PROP_CRAFTXP

Source: [arc_properties.ini](../../CoffeeMud/resources/help/arc_properties.ini), line 747.

```text
Property   : Prop_CraftXP
Targets    : MOBs, Items, Rooms, Areas
Parameters : (PCT=[PCT]) (GATHER=[N]) (SKILLS=[SKILL ID],...) (MASK="[ZAPPER MASK]")
Example    : PCT=50 GATHER=2 SKILLS=Blacksmithing,Mining MASK="-LEVEL +<20"
Description:
CoffeeSUD: crafting and gathering XP for a player character of any class.  When their
crafting, cooking or building skill makes something, it has an XP value (what an Artisan
earns for it): CRAFTXP=[PCT] in the ini gives every player character that percent of it, and
 PCT here adds its own.  When a gathering skill finds something, GATHERXP=[N] in the ini,
and GATHER here, are XP for every unit found.  It counts on the character, on an item they
carry, on the room or an item lying in it, and on the area or one of its parents, as PCT=50
on a guild hall that teaches.  SKILLS are the skills it is for (all when not given) and MASK
 who it is for.  The XP goes through the usual way, so Prop_ModExperience and achievements
see it, and an Artisan earns it on top of their own.
```

<a id="prop-croprules"></a>

## PROP_CROPRULES

Source: [arc_properties.ini](../../CoffeeMud/resources/help/arc_properties.ini), line 762.

```text
Property   : Prop_CropRules
Targets    : Rooms, Areas, Items
Parameters : (GROWHOURS=[N]) (SEASONS=[SEASON],...) (NEEDSUN=true/false) (DOMAINS=[ROOM
TYPE],...) (WATER=[N]) (YIELD=[DICE]) (FAILMSG="[TEXT]")
Example    : NEEDSUN=false DOMAINS=CAVE,STONE FAILMSG="Only the cellar beds will take that."
Description:
CoffeeSUD: crop rules for Farming and Gardening, on a room or an area (all crops there) or
on the seed itself.  GROWHOURS is how many game hours the crop takes to grow (50 ticks when
not given); a crop given hours is not set back by the nights while it grows.  SEASONS are
when it may be planted (SPRING, SUMMER, AUTUMN, WINTER).  NEEDSUN=false lets it grow without
 sunlight.  DOMAINS are the kinds of room it grows in (PLAINS, HILLS, WOODS, JUNGLE, SWAMP,
CAVE, STONE..., or ANY), in place of the usual farmland.  WATER is how many water rooms,
this one or those next to it (a pond Irrigation digs counts), it needs.  YIELD is dice, as
2d6+1, in place of 1d7, still times the skill's yield.  FAILMSG is told when one of them
refuses.  A world can give a crop its rules in world/crops.txt, a line each: the resource or
 subtype, then these rules, as WHEAT GROWHOURS=240 SEASONS=AUTUMN.  The area's, the room's
and the seed's come over the file's, in that order.
```

<a id="prop-cursed"></a>

## PROP_CURSED

Source: [arc_properties.ini](../../CoffeeMud/resources/help/arc_properties.ini), line 788.

```text
Property   : Prop_Cursed
Targets    : Items
Parameters : (LEVEL=[N]) (HIDDEN) (NOREMOVE) (NODROP) (PENALTY="[ID]([ARGS]);[ID]([ARGS])")
(REVEAL="[TEXT]") (BREAK="SAY:[WORDS];ENTER:[ROOM ID]") (BREAKMASK="[ZAPPER MASK]")
(ONBREAK=CRUMBLE/KEEP/BECOME:[ITEM]) (BREAKMSG="[TEXT]")
Example    : LEVEL=15 HIDDEN NOREMOVE
PENALTY="Prop_WearAdjuster(wis-3);Prop_WearSpellCast(Prayer_CurseLuck)" REVEAL="The ring
tightens on your finger!" BREAK="SAY:i confess;ENTER:Chapel#3" ONBREAK=CRUMBLE
Description:
CoffeeSUD: a curse on an item that Remove Curse ends cleanly.  It is of the cursing domain,
so Remove Curse finds it, but only a priest of LEVEL or more lifts it.  HIDDEN shows nothing
 until it is first worn, when REVEAL is told.  NOREMOVE and NODROP keep it on and in hand.
PENALTY is what it does (properties and their arguments, a semicolon between).  BREAK is a
list of deeds, done in order by the one who has it (SAY:[WORDS], ENTER:[ROOM ID]); BREAKMASK
 a mask they come to fit.  Lifted or broken, its penalties go with it, and the item stays
(KEEP), crumbles (CRUMBLE), or becomes another (BECOME:[ITEM]).
```

```text
Example    : LOST=10% STUMBLE=5% LURKER=ghoul LURK=3%
Description:
CoffeeSUD: dangers for a player the room is dark to (dark, and they cannot see in the dark;
a lit torch ends it).  LOST: a move goes a random open way (MSG says so).  STUMBLE: a move
fails and costs movement (STUMBLEMSG).  LURKER: as they come in, the catalog's mob of that
name (or a mob class) comes out of the dark, LURK percent of the time (LURKMSG).
```

```text
ID]) (GEAR=CONTAINER:[ROOM ID]/[CONTAINER]) (HEAL=[N]%) (MSG="[TEXT]") (MASK="[ZAPPER
```

```text
Property   : Prop_Detector
Targets    : Items
Parameters : (DETECT="[ZAPPER MASK]") (DETECTITEM="[ZAPPER MASK]") (RANGE=[0-3])
(WHERE=WORN/HELD/ANY) (EVERY=[TICKS]) (AMBIANCE="[TEXT]") (MSG="[TEXT]") (STOPMSG="[TEXT]")

CoffeeSUD: an item that reacts to what is near: mobs that DETECT fits, or items that

looks; while it finds something it has AMBIANCE, and the one carrying it (or the room it
```

```text
A developer's cheats, which the GOD command sets: see AHELP GOD for what each does.  A
cheat's name turns it on; a minus and a cheat's name turns it off, even where a sysop power
would give it; a minus and a security flag (as in AHELP SECURITY) suspends that power for
```

<a id="prop-discoverable"></a>

## PROP_DISCOVERABLE

Source: [arc_properties.ini](../../CoffeeMud/resources/help/arc_properties.ini), line 855.

```text
Property   : Prop_Discoverable
Targets    : Items, Exits, MOBs
Parameters : (FOUNDBY=examine:[THING]|look:[THING]|search) (CHECK="[STAT] [NUMBER]")
(DC=[NUMBER]) (STAT=[STAT]) (MSG="[TEXT]") (HINT="[TEXT]") (STAYS=false) (RESET=[TICKS])
Example    : FOUNDBY=examine:tapestry MSG="Behind the tapestry is a narrow door." HINT="The
tapestry stirs in a draught."
Example    : FOUNDBY=search|examine:fireplace CHECK="INT 12"
Description:
CoffeeSUD: something hidden that anyone can find.  Until it is found nobody sees it, and
nobody goes through a hidden exit.  FOUNDBY (search, by default): EXAMINE of that thing
here, LOOK at it (look:), or SEARCH, which needs no skill (one SEARCH looks for all there is
 in the room).  CHECK (or STAT and DC): a d20, the stat's (N-10)/2 and a tenth of
Searching's or Thief_Search's proficiency against the number; with none, it is found at
once.  MSG is what the finder is told; HINT is added when one of its FOUNDBY things is
looked at.  Once found it stays found (kept with it), unless STAYS=false, which hides it
again RESET ticks (30) later.
```

<a id="prop-discovery"></a>

## PROP_DISCOVERY

Source: [arc_properties.ini](../../CoffeeMud/resources/help/arc_properties.ini), line 925.

```text
Property   : Prop_Discovery
Targets    : Rooms, Exits, Items, MOBs
Parameters : XP=[N or N%] ON=[ENTER/LOOK/READ/OPEN/GET/FIND/TALK]
ONCE=[CHARACTER/PARTY/PROFILE] MESSAGE="..." TATTOO=[NAME] MASK="..." JOURNAL="..."
Example    : XP=150 ONCE=PARTY MESSAGE="Behind the falls lies a hidden grotto!"
TATTOO=FOUND_GROTTO
Description:
CoffeeSUD: a discovery.  The first time its event happens to a character (ON: ENTER the
room, LOOK at it, READ, OPEN, GET, TALK to the mob, or FIND it when it is hidden with
Prop_Discoverable; by default ENTER for a room, OPEN an exit, GET an item, TALK a mob) and
MASK lets them in, they get XP (a number, or a percent of their level's experience; tagged
DISCOVERY:, so XPMOD can scale it), are told MESSAGE, get a JOURNAL line in their quest
journal, and the tattoo TATTOO (or one of its own) marks it done: for them, their whole
party (ONCE=PARTY) or every character of the profile (ONCE=PROFILE).  DISCOVERYXP=[formula]
in the ini or world.ini pays each room a character enters for the first time (@x1 their
level, @x2 the area's median level).
```

```text
Example    : TICKS=3 HEAL=5
Description:
CoffeeSUD: down (PLAYERDEATH's DOWNED puts it on one of the player's side at 0 hit points).
  For TICKS rounds (3) the character lies there: it cannot move, strike, cast or stand, and
is not attacked.  An ally's REVIVE, or a heal of HEAL hit points (1) or more, brings them
back.  When the foes that downed them are gone or dead, and no one of the party there still

list applies.
```

<a id="prop-durability"></a>

## PROP_DURABILITY

Source: [arc_properties.ini](../../CoffeeMud/resources/help/arc_properties.ini), line 1050.

```text
Property   : Prop_Durability
Targets    : Items
Parameters : (MULT=[PERCENT]) (UNBREAKABLE) (NOREPAIR) (BREAK=true) (BROKENNAME="[NAME with
%s]")
Example    : MULT=50 BROKENNAME="a shattered %s"
Example    : UNBREAKABLE
Description:
CoffeeSUD: an item's own wear and tear.  MULT is the percent of the usual wear it takes
(with coffeemud.ini's ITEMWEAR); UNBREAKABLE takes none.  BREAK or BROKENNAME: worn out, it
breaks rather than goes (as ITEMBREAK=BREAK does for all), and BROKENNAME names it so (%s
its old name).  A broken item cannot be worn, held or wielded, gives no armour or damage,
and shows as (broken), until it is mended (MEND, a smith); then it has its name back.
NOREPAIR: nobody mends it.  Below half its condition it shows as (worn).
```

<a id="prop-essential"></a>

## PROP_ESSENTIAL

Source: [arc_properties.ini](../../CoffeeMud/resources/help/arc_properties.ini), line 1113.

```text
Property   : Prop_Essential
Targets    : MOBs
Parameters : (MODE=YIELD/KNOCKOUT) (AT=[N]%) (TICKS=[N]) (MSG="[TEXT]") (REFUSEMSG="[TEXT]")
 (NOXP)
Example    : MODE=YIELD AT=10% TICKS=20 MSG="<S-NAME> drop(s) to one knee and yield(s)!"
Example    : MODE=KNOCKOUT TICKS=10
Description:
CoffeeSUD: a mob the story needs alive, or one that gives up.  MODE=YIELD: under AT percent
of its hit points (10) it stops fighting, as do its foes, MSG shows, and its scripts'
YIELD_PROG runs ($n who beat it), so a script can spare it, take its key, or finish it.
MODE=KNOCKOUT: a blow that would kill it leaves it at 1 hit point, out cold, and DEFEAT_PROG
 runs.  Either way, for TICKS ticks (20) attacks on it are refused with REFUSEMSG, and the
one who beat it gains the experience of a kill, unless NOXP.
```

<a id="prop-haveadjuster"></a>

## PROP_HAVEADJUSTER

Source: [arc_properties.ini](../../CoffeeMud/resources/help/arc_properties.ini), line 1204.

```text
Property   : Prop_HaveAdjuster
Targets    : Items
Parameters : statistic names followed by a +, -, or = and a value
Parameters : The above parameters may be followed by an optional mask
Example    : str+2 dex-2 class=thief race=elf allset=aname-3
Example    : str+2 ableprofs="spell_fireball(10)" MASK=-Race +Dwarf
Description:
So long as the item with this property is owned, the listed effects will be given to the
owner.  All parameters use the + or - adjuster, except the class, race, gender, ableprofs,
and ablelvls parameters. Valid parameters are as follows:
strength dexterity constitution charisma wisdom intelligence
maxstr maxdex maxcon maxcha maxwis maxint (maximum trainable)
savepar savefir savecol savewat savegas savemin savegen savejus
saveaci saveele savepoi saveund savemag savedis savetra
ability (magical level), armor, attacks (prowess), damage (max), disposition (see AHELP
ADJDISPOSITION), level, rejuv(!NO!), senses (see AHELP ADJSENSES), speed (#attacks), height,
 weight, ambiance+``,gender, class, race, hitpoints, hunger (stomach size), mana, movement,
thirst (stomach size) conversion weightadj saveblunt savepierce saveslash savespells
saveprayers savesongs savechants critpctweapons critpctmagic critdmgweapons critdmgmagic
faith deity rejuvrate xpadjpct. Ableprofs and ablelvls is a commma-delimited list of
ablityids followed by a number in parenthesis to adjust proficiency or casting level by.

By default, the values + or - are added to the existing values.  However, if MULTIPLYPH=true
 is included in the parameters, then attack, armor, damage, weight and height will instead
have their values multiplied by the given value / 100, and speed by the given value itself
(SPEED+1.5 is one and a half times). Likewise, if MULTIPLYCH=true is included, then
hitpoints, mana, and movement are similarly multiplied instead of added.  All other values
act the same.
Parameters may also include ALLSET=[SET_NAME]-[NUMBER] where SET_NAME is a arbitrary
un-spaced name of the set to which the item belongs.  Only when [NUMBER] items in that set
are possessed (or worn for Prop_WearAdjuster) will all of the stats be adjusted according to
 their parameters.

The parameters may also END with the key word MASK= followed by a mask.  This mask will
select which kinds of mobs and players will be affected by this property. See ZAPPERMASKS
for more information on zapper mask syntax.
```

<a id="prop-haveresister"></a>

## PROP_HAVERESISTER

Source: [arc_properties.ini](../../CoffeeMud/resources/help/arc_properties.ini), line 1266.

```text
Property   : Prop_HaveResister
Targets    : Items
Parameters : resistance names followed by percentages
Parameters : Parameters may be followed by an optional mask
Example    : magic 50% poison -10%
Example    : magic poison 50% pierce -10% MASK=-RACE +Dwarf
Example    : fire 40% SOURCEMASK="-RACECAT +Dragon"
CoffeeSUD: SOURCEMASK="[ZAPPER MASK]" makes it work only against the attackers it fits;
MASK= is still whom it protects.
Description:
So long as the item with this property is owned, the owner will gain certain resistances and
 immunities in the parameters. The effects which may be included are:
Resistances: gas fire electricity mind magic cold acid water evil (undead)
Resistances: justice (as per many thief abilities)
Resistances: weapons blunt pierce slash non-magical-weapons non-silver-weapons
Resistances:  -- weapons get reduced % damage per round, lvl based, with limits.
:          :  -- always modifier makes weapon resists always work, no limits.
Resistances: spell chant song prayer thief_skill (ability types)
Resistances: enchantment/charm kicking vexing conjuration (ability domains)
Immunities : teleport (includes gate, summon) holy disease poison
Misc       : debuf-duration (pct is the maximum debuf ticks remain)

The parameters may also END with the key word MASK= followed by a mask.  This mask will
select which kinds of mobs and players will be affected by this property. See ZAPPERMASKS
for more information on zapper mask syntax.
```

<a id="prop-hazard"></a>

## PROP_HAZARD

Source: [arc_properties.ini](../../CoffeeMud/resources/help/arc_properties.ini), line 979.

```text
Property   : Prop_Hazard
Targets    : Rooms, Areas
Parameters : TYPE=[TYPE] DAMAGE=[DICE/FORMULA] (SAVE=[TYPE]) (DRAIN=MOVE/MANA) (AFFECT="[ID]
 [PCT]%") (ROOMS="[MASK]") (WHEN="[MASK]") (PROTECT="[MASK]") (EVERY=[TICKS])
(ONSET=[TICKS]) (ESCALATE=[PCT]) (WARN="[TEXT]") (DARKONLY) (LITONLY) (NONPC)
(NAME="[TEXT]") (MSG="[TEXT]")
Example    : TYPE=COLD DAMAGE=1d6 SAVE=COLD WHEN="-WEATHER +BLIZZARD +SNOW"
PROTECT="-EFFECTS +Spell_ResistCold" ESCALATE=20
Example    : TYPE=HEAT DAMAGE=@x1/2 ROOMS="-DOMAIN +DESERT" WARN="The sand burns through
your boots."
Description:
CoffeeSUD: a hazard zone.  Each tick (EVERY) those in the room, or in the area (ROOMS a mask
 on each of them, as -DOMAIN +MOUNTAINS, for some of its rooms), take DAMAGE as TYPE's
damage (COLD, HEAT, ACID, GAS, POISON, ELECTRIC, HOLY, UNHOLY, DISEASE, THINAIR), so
resistances count: dice as 1d6+2 or a formula, @x1 their level.  SAVE names the save that
halves it (the type's own by default). DRAIN=MOVE or MANA takes it from moves or mana
instead (THINAIR's default).  AFFECT may give an effect, that percent of the time.  WHEN is
a mask checked on each every tick (the weather, the time), PROTECT the mask of those it
spares; ONSET ticks pass before it starts, ESCALATE adds that percent each time in a row;
WARN is said once as it starts.  DARKONLY and LITONLY: only in the dark, or the light;
NONPC: players only.  NAME is what hurts (the biting cold), MSG the damage line.
```

<a id="prop-homestead"></a>

```text
Property   : Prop_Homestead

(MAXROOMS=[N]) (PRICE=[N]) (NOTAX)
Example    : SKILLS=Construction,Masonry MAXROOMS=3
Description:
CoffeeSUD: land a character may build on without buying a deed, on a room or every room of
an area.  MASK is a zapper mask the builder must pass, and SKILLS the building skills
allowed (all when not given).  With CLAIM=TRUE (the default) the first build in a room with
no title claims it: the room gets a Prop_LotsForSale owned by the builder (by @PROFILE, the
whole profile, with CLAIM=PROFILE or PROFILEPROPERTY=true), priced PRICE (1 by default, and
at 1 no property tax is due; NOTAX keeps it at 1), and with MAXROOMS a Prop_ReqCapacity, so
the lot grows by the usual building rules to MAXROOMS rooms at most.  If that build does not
 start (no materials, say), the claim is taken back.  With CLAIM=FALSE they may build there
with no title at all.
```

```text
Will (eventually) cause the death of anyone using the item, attacking the mob, or entering
the room or area.  If a mask if given, only those matching the mask are killed. If a DMGPCT
```

<a id="prop-invokable"></a>

## PROP_INVOKABLE

Source: [arc_properties.ini](../../CoffeeMud/resources/help/arc_properties.ini), line 1489.

```text
Property   : Prop_Invokable
Targets    : Items
Parameters : (WORD="[WORD]") (VERB=[VERB]) SPELLS="[ID];LEVEL=[N],[ID]"
(TARGET=SELF/ENEMY/ROOM) (CHARGES=[N]) (RECHARGE=DAWN/DAILY/TICKS=[N]) (COOLDOWN=[TICKS])
(REQUIRE=WORN/HELD) (MASK="[ZAPPER MASK]") (MSG="[TEXT]") (EMPTYMSG="[TEXT]")
Example    : WORD=Ignis SPELLS="Spell_Fireball;LEVEL=12" TARGET=ENEMY CHARGES=3
RECHARGE=DAWN REQUIRE=WORN EMPTYMSG="The ring is cold."
Description:
CoffeeSUD: an item's powers on demand, for anyone, with no class skill.  Its holder says
WORD, or types VERB and its name (INVOKE [ITEM], the default without a WORD).  It casts
SPELLS, each at LEVEL (or the item's level), on its user (SELF), their foe (ENEMY) or about
them (ROOM).  CHARGES is how many uses it holds (what is left is kept with it); RECHARGE
fills them again at dawn, each game day, or every N ticks.  COOLDOWN ticks pass between
uses.  REQUIRE: it must be worn, or held.  MASK is who may use it.  MSG is what the room
sees (<S-NAME> the user, <T-NAME> the item); EMPTYMSG what they are told when it is spent.
Identifying it tells its charges and recharge.
```

<a id="prop-itemgrowth"></a>

## PROP_ITEMGROWTH

Source: [arc_properties.ini](../../CoffeeMud/resources/help/arc_properties.ini), line 1526.

```text
Property   : Prop_ItemGrowth
Targets    : Items
Parameters : (GAIN=KILL/HIT/USE/WORNTICK) (XP="[FORMULA]") (KILLMASK="[ZAPPER MASK]")
STAGES="[N]:NAME='[NAME]' PROPS=[ID]([ARGS]);[N]:..." (MSG="[TEXT]") (BIND=CHARACTER)
Example    : GAIN=KILL XP="@x1" KILLMASK="-RACECAT +Undead" STAGES="100:NAME='a humming
blade' PROPS=Prop_WearAdjuster(dam+2);400:NAME='Dawnbringer' PROPS=Prop_WearAdjuster(dam+5)"
 MSG="$p shudders as it grows stronger!" BIND=CHARACTER
Description:
CoffeeSUD: an item that grows with use.  GAIN: the kills of the one who wields or wears it
(KILL; KILLMASK is which), its hits (HIT), anything done with it (USE), or each tick worn
(WORNTICK).  Each gives XP (a formula, @x1 the slain's level; 1 by default).  STAGES: at
each amount it takes the NAME (DISPLAY too) and PROPS of that stage (a semicolon before each
 next stage), and its holder is told MSG ($p the item).  BIND=CHARACTER: it grows for its
first owner only.  Its growth, stage and owner are kept with it; identifying it shows the
stage and the way to the next.
```

```text
TIER4="Prop_WearSpellCast(Spell_WaterBreathing);Prop_WearEnabler(Chant_Tsunami)" ONMSG="The
regalia stirs."
Example    : SET=drowned_king
Description:
CoffeeSUD: a piece of an item set.  Every piece has SET, the set's id; one piece (or a line
of world/itemsets.txt, SET=[ID] NAME=... TIER2=..., for a set none of whose pieces says) has
 the tiers: TIER[N] what wearing N pieces gives (COUNT=HELD: carrying them), properties and
their arguments in brackets, a semicolon between.  Every tier met applies: its properties go
 on one of the counted pieces, unsaved, and come off when a piece does.  ONMSG and OFFMSG
tell the wearer as a tier comes and goes ($t the tier); MASK is who may have them; PIECES
how many there are.  LOOK at a piece shows "Set: 3/5 worn" and each tier.  Scripts:
SETCOUNT([CODE] [SET]) and SET_PROG.  The ALLSET of Prop_HaveAdjuster and Prop_WearAdjuster
now gives each piece its own number of pieces needed.
```

<a id="prop-journey"></a>

## PROP_JOURNEY

Source: [arc_travel.ini](../../CoffeeMud/resources/help/arc_travel.ini), line 25.

```text
Property: Prop_Journey
Targets: Exits, Rooms, Items, MOBs
Parameters: DEST=[room or port] DURATION=[game hours] VIA=[transit room] FARE=[price]
PARTY=LEADER|EACH PERHEAD=true MISSING=WAIT|CONTINUE|RESCUE|CANCEL|RETURN
DEAD=CONTINUE|WAIT|CANCEL|RETURN DISCONNECTED=TRAVEL|WAIT|CONTINUE|CANCEL|RETURN
CANCEL=HERE|RETURN REFUND=NONE|FULL|UNUSED LEAVEMSG="[text]" ARRIVEMSG="[text]"
EVENTS="[chance%:action;...]"
Entering the host or JOURNEY <host> starts a passage for the nearby party. Each game hour
rolls EVENTS: a script function, LOAD MOB <spec>, or CATALOG <encounter table>. A function
returning PAUSE waits for JOURNEY RESUME. Combat pauses travel. Saves retain elapsed hours,
remaining leg time, scenes and individual passengers.
Missing/dead/disconnected passenger policies are checked before advancing or arriving. WAIT
pauses without spending time; CONTINUE releases the seat. RESCUE obeys movement checks.
RETURN brings the present party to the origin; refused returns stay paused. Saved fare
receipts support full or unused-time refunds once per payer. Defaults: MISSING=WAIT
DEAD=CONTINUE DISCONNECTED=TRAVEL CANCEL=HERE REFUND=NONE.
JOURNEY_PROG START|HOUR|ARRIVE|CANCEL|ALL: $g is the stage, $0 completed game hours and $1
the destination room ID.
```

<a id="prop-keyrules"></a>

## PROP_KEYRULES

Source: [arc_properties.ini](../../CoffeeMud/resources/help/arc_properties.ini), line 1642.

```text
Property   : Prop_KeyRules
Targets    : Items (keys)
Parameters : (CONSUME=true) (BREAK=[PERCENT]) (RETURN=[ROOM ID]) (MASK="[ZAPPER MASK]")
(MSG="[TEXT]")
Example    : CONSUME=true
Example    : RETURN=Castle#12 MASK="-CLASSES +Thief" MSG="The key will not turn for you."
Description:
CoffeeSUD: rules for a key.  CONSUME: it crumbles once it has unlocked something; BREAK:
that percent of the time it snaps when it is used; RETURN: once used it goes back to that
room; MASK: who may use it (MSG is told to the others).  A key's code may also be a list
(crypt;vault: it opens both) or end in * (jail.*: a master key for jail.1, jail.2...), and a
 key on a keyring is found however deep the keyring is in a pack.
```

```text
Example    : Weaponsmithing|moonblade
Description:
CoffeeSUD: the recipes a character knows, kept with them.  A whole recipe line (tabs and
all) is a recipe of that skill as a recipe book's would be, without the book; a name makes
one of the skill's own recipes known, as one marked HIDDEN=1 (AHELP RECIPEKEYS), which no
one else sees.  LEARN FROM a recipe book copies its recipes in, and scripts use
MPLEARNRECIPE and KNOWSRECIPE().  With PROFILERECIPES=true in the ini, every character of
the profile knows what any of them knows.
```

```text
ID=stable-id ALIASES=old-id LEGACYKEYS=old-token
```

<a id="prop-languagespeaker"></a>

## PROP_LANGUAGESPEAKER

Source: [arc_properties.ini](../../CoffeeMud/resources/help/arc_properties.ini), line 1691.

```text
Property   : Prop_LanguageSpeaker
Targets    : Mobs, Items, Rooms, Exits, Areas
Parameters : LANGUAGE=[LANGUAGE] (UNDERSTANDS=ONLY) (HOMEONLY=TRUE/FALSE)
(NOMOBS=TRUE/FALSE)
Parms(Cont):    (PLAYERS=TRUE/FALSE) (; [ZAPPER MASK])
Example    : LANGUAGE=Dwarven
Example    : LANGUAGE=Dwarven players=true ; -NAMES +BOB
Example    : LANGUAGE=SignLanguage homeonly=true ; -NAMES +BOB
Description:
This is property forces the mobs who become affected by this property to speak the
designated language until something else stops them.  On a mob, the affected mob will speak
the language.  On a room, those who enter or are born in a room may be speak the language.
On an area, those who enter or are born in a room may speak the language. On an exits, those
 who enter the exit may speak the language. On an item, those who pick up the item may start
 speaking the language, while putting it down will stop them.

On a mob, UNDERSTANDS=ONLY removes automatic Common comprehension while allowing learned
languages and translators. See PROP_MONOLINGUAL. The parameters affect who will start
speaking the language.  By default, any non-player mob will become affected.  HOMEONLY will
force only those whose starting room is in the area to speak.  NOMOBS will eliminate all
non-players from consideration.  PLAYERS will allow players to be affected.  An optional
zapper mask may follow a semicolon to add additional masks. <ZAP=disallow>
```

<a id="prop-limitedcontents"></a>

## PROP_LIMITEDCONTENTS

Source: [arc_properties.ini](../../CoffeeMud/resources/help/arc_properties.ini), line 1715.

```text
Property   : Prop_LimitedContents
Targets    : Items, Rooms, Areas
Parameters : [MAX NUM] ([MASK]) (; [...] / MSG="[MESSAGE]" ACTUAL=[T/F] LOCKIN=true
LOCKMSG="[MESSAGE]" CONSUME=true ONPUT="[ACTIONS]" ONFULL="[ACTIONS]" ONEMPTY="[ACTIONS]")
Example    : 3 -javaclass +genweapon
Example    : 3;msg="Can't do it!"
Example    : 2 -TAGS +DRAGONEYE;0;MSG="It does not fit.";LOCKIN=true;ONFULL="door open here
north; echo The dragon's mouth grinds open."
Description:
This property will ensure that no more than the given number of items that match the given
mask may be either put into the container, or dropped in a room.  Multiple masks may be
specified.  The first mask that the item matches will be applied.  Matching NONE of the
masks means no limit of those items.  CoffeeSUD: a container is also a receptacle.  LOCKIN
keeps what is put in it in it (LOCKMSG is told); CONSUME makes what is put in vanish, while
still counting it (kept as TALLY=).  ONPUT runs when something goes in, ONFULL when each
limit above 0 is met, ONEMPTY when the last thing is taken out: script commands, a semicolon
 between them, MP left off if you like, $n who did it (as Prop_Switch's).  A semicolon
inside quotes does not split the parts.
```

```text
 and miss text has six stock attack categories. DAMAGE_WORDS accepts flat severity words or
a stock grid. Weapons use the wielder's context, including unowned racial natural weapons.
Prop_SkyText overrides its own time-of-day text first.
```

```text
CoffeeSUD: rules for a lock.  PICK=NEVER: no thief picks it; PICK=LEVEL:30: only one of that
```

<a id="prop-loottable"></a>

## PROP_LOOTTABLE

Source: [arc_properties.ini](../../CoffeeMud/resources/help/arc_properties.ini), line 1035.

```text
Property   : Prop_LootTable
Targets    : MOBs, Items
Parameters : FILE=[TEMPLATE FILE] ID=[ITEM TAG ID] (ROLLS=[MATH])
(ON=DEATH/OPEN/SPAWN/RESET) (CHANCE=[PCT]) (GOLD=[MATH])
Example    : FILE=randareas/loot.xml ID=goblin ROLLS=0?2 ON=DEATH GOLD=1?10
Example    : FILE=randareas/loot.xml ID=chest ROLLS=1?3 ON=OPEN
Description:
CoffeeSUD: a loot table: the ITEM tag ID of a template file (resources/randareas/, or the
world's own), rolled ROLLS times, each a fresh roll with $mob_level, $area_level, $theme and
 $player_level set, if CHANCE (a percent, 100 by default) allows, and GOLD as money.
ON=DEATH (a mob's default) puts it in the mob's corpse as it dies; ON=OPEN (a container's
default) the first time the container is opened, and it stays rolled until its contents
reset (a save keeps that); ON=SPAWN or RESET as the mob is brought to life, or as a player
first comes into the container's room.  A catalog entry (class="catalog") keeps the
catalog's cap.  resources/randareas/loot.xml has sample tables (goblin, chest).
```

<a id="prop-mobrank"></a>

## PROP_MOBRANK

Source: [arc_properties.ini](../../CoffeeMud/resources/help/arc_properties.ini), line 1900.

```text
Property   : Prop_MobRank
Targets    : MOBs
Parameters : RANK=[MINION/NORMAL/ELITE/BOSS/ANOTHER]
Example    : RANK=BOSS
Description:
CoffeeSUD: the mob's rank.  It gets the rank's numbers, from MOBRANK_[NAME] in coffeemud.ini
 (or a world's world.ini): HP+n% DAMAGE+n% ATTACK+n ARMOR-n (lower is better) SPEED+n, XP*x
(the experience for killing it), RESIST="fire 25% mind 25%" (saving throws), POWER=x (what
an encounter budget counts it as) and TAG=text, which LOOK and CONSIDER show.  The numbers
are read each time the mob's stats are worked out, so one edit retunes every mob of the
rank.  The defaults: MINION HP-50% DAMAGE-25% ATTACK-10 XP*0.5 TAG=[minion]; NORMAL nothing;
 ELITE HP+100% DAMAGE+25% ATTACK+10 ARMOR-10 XP*2.5 TAG=[elite]; BOSS HP+300% DAMAGE+50%
ATTACK+20 ARMOR-20 XP*5 TAG=[boss].  A world may add ranks of its own
(MOBRANK_CHAMPION=...).  Scripts read RANK($i) (NORMAL for a mob without one) or test
RANK($i == BOSS); masks take -RANK +ELITE +BOSS (only those) and +RANK -MINION (not those).
```

<a id="prop-npclines"></a>

## PROP_NPCLINES

Source: [arc_properties.ini](../../CoffeeMud/resources/help/arc_properties.ini), line 2287.

```text
Property   : Prop_NPCLines
Targets    : MOBs, Areas
Parameters : [KEY]="[TEXT]"(|"[TEXT]")([MASK]) ...  or  "[STOCK LINE]"="[TEXT]" ...
Example    : NOTBUYING="Bah! I've no use for that junk."|"Take that rubbish elsewhere."
STOLEN="I know where that came from, $n."
Description:
CoffeeSUD: the NPC's own words for the stock lines a shopkeeper, banker, postman, hireling
or the like says.  Each entry names a line by a short key or by the line itself in quotes;
its text is what is said instead, one of several split by | at random, with @x1, @x2... the
line's values (a price, an item) and $n the one spoken to.  A [MASK] after the text makes it
 that customer's alone, and such entries come first; [AFFINITY >=25] or [AFFINITY FRIENDLY]
tests the NPC's opinion of them (AHELP PROP_AFFINITY).  An empty text says nothing.  On an
area it gives the whole town's words; an NPC's own come first.  The keys: NOTBUYING (I'm not
 interested.), NOTBUYINGTHOSE, STOLEN, OUTOFSTOCK, TOOPOOR (@x1 the item), SHOPPOOR,
TOODEAR, OFFER (@x1 the price, @x2 the item), FIRM, TOOADVANCED, TOOLOW, CLANSONLY, BALANCE,
 NOLOANS, ACCOUNTCLOSED, ONLYCURRENCY, SAFE, DELIVER, FORHIRE, HIRED, PRICE, ONTHEJOB,
TIMEUP, GOODBYE, WONTWORK, SKILLS.  Any other line the NPC says may be named in quotes.
```

<a id="prop-partyscaler"></a>

## PROP_PARTYSCALER

Source: [arc_properties.ini](../../CoffeeMud/resources/help/arc_properties.ini), line 2350.

```text
Property   : Prop_PartyScaler
Targets    : MOBs, Rooms, Areas
Parameters : (BASE=[N]) (HP=+[N]%/MEMBER) (DAMAGE=+[N]%/MEMBER) (ATTACK=+[N]/MEMBER)
(LEVEL=AVG+[N]/MAX+[N]) (MIN=[N]) (MAX=[N]) (ADDS="[NAME]/MEMBER-ABOVE-[N]")
Example    : BASE=3 HP=+25%/MEMBER DAMAGE=+10%/MEMBER ADDS="catalog:a skeleton
guard/MEMBER-ABOVE-3"
Example    : LEVEL=AVG+2 MIN=5 MAX=20
Description:
CoffeeSUD: a fight scaled to the party.  When the mob's fight starts it counts the party:
its foes' groups in the room, followers too.  For each member over BASE (3), or under it,
its hit points go up or down HP percent, its damage DAMAGE percent and its attack ATTACK;
LEVEL=AVG+N or MAX+N makes its level the party's average or highest plus N, within MIN and
MAX; ADDS brings one add (the catalog's, or a class) for each member over N, following it.
It holds until the fight ends, when the adds go.  On a room or an area, each NPC there that
fights the party gets it for that fight.  CONSIDER says that the mob scales to your party.
It counts builders too, so PLAYTEST shows it as a player would see it.
```

<a id="prop-pressureplate"></a>

## PROP_PRESSUREPLATE

Source: [arc_properties.ini](../../CoffeeMud/resources/help/arc_properties.ini), line 2385.

```text
Property   : Prop_PressurePlate
Targets    : Rooms, Items
Parameters : (WEIGHT=[TEST]) (COUNT=[TEST]) (MASK="[ZAPPER MASK]") (ON="[ACTIONS]")
(OFF="[ACTIONS]") (MSGON="[TEXT]") (MSGOFF="[TEXT]") (DELAY=[TICKS])
Example    : WEIGHT=">=50" OFF="cast Spell_Lightning $n" MSGOFF="The pedestal rises with a
click!"
Example    : COUNT=">=2" ON="door open here north" OFF="door close here north" DELAY=2
Description:
CoffeeSUD: a pressure plate.  On a room it weighs the mobs there (with all they carry) and
the items lying there; on a fixture, what is on or in it and who sits on it.  WEIGHT and
COUNT (of the mobs) are tests: >=120, >50, <=10, <3, =2, or a number (at least).  MASK is
what counts.  When it goes down ON runs and MSGON shows; when it comes up again OFF runs and
 MSGOFF shows, DELAY ticks later if given (it stays down if pressed again meanwhile).  It
looks again when someone enters or leaves, things are got, put or dropped, or someone sits
or stands on it.  Actions are script commands, as in Prop_Switch.  Scripts have ROOMWEIGHT()
 and CONTENTWEIGHT().
```

<a id="prop-questboard"></a>

## PROP_QUESTBOARD

Source: [arc_properties.ini](../../CoffeeMud/resources/help/arc_properties.ini), line 2130.

```text
Property   : Prop_QuestBoard
Targets    : Items, Rooms
Parameters : (COUNT=[N]) (REFRESH="[GAME TIME]") (TEMPLATE=[TEMPLATE]) (VARS="[NAME]=[VALUE]
 ...") (FILE=[PATH]) (TAGID=[ID]) (LEVELRANGE=[N])
Example    : COUNT=3 REFRESH="1 mudday" TEMPLATE=normal LEVELRANGE=3
Description:
CoffeeSUD: a board of jobs, quests generated as the RandomQuests behavior makes them
(TEMPLATE, FILE as its PATH, TAGID, and its other parameters, such as SOURCENAME= for the
giver, are passed on; VARS sets more of the generator's variables).  LOOK at the board (or
READ it, if the item is readable; LOOK in the room, on a room) lists the jobs the reader may
 take, COUNT of them (3), and ACCEPT [NUMBER] takes one.  At each REFRESH (1 MUDDAY, or
MUDDAY:1), on the game clock, the jobs done or given up go and new ones come up to COUNT, or
 with none taken the oldest is replaced; a job taken stays until it is done.  The generator
is told the reader's PLAYER_LEVEL, PARTY_SIZE (the players' characters of their group),
PLAYER_FACTION_[ID] and QUESTS_DONE, and with LEVELRANGE=[N] TARGET_MIN_AREALEVEL and
TARGET_MAX_AREALEVEL that far around the level.  A job waits on the board with no expiry
unless EXPIRE= says one.  The jobs are kept in a saved game with the board.
```

<a id="prop-questgiver"></a>

## PROP_QUESTGIVER

Source: [arc_properties.ini](../../CoffeeMud/resources/help/arc_properties.ini), line 2415.

```text
Property   : Prop_QuestGiver
Targets    : Areas, Exits, Items, Mobs, Rooms
Parameters : QUEST="[NAME]/GENERATE:([ARGS])" (MESSAGE="[ANNOUNCEMENT]")
Parameters : (DETAILS="TRUE/FALSE") (OPTIONAL="TRUE/FALSE") (REOFFER="ALWAYS/ONCE/[GAME
TIME]")
Parameters : (TRIGGER="GET/ENTER/LEAVE/PUTIN/DEATH/SPEAK/WEAR/WIELD/READ")
Example    : quest="save_the_day" message="You found a quest item" trigger=GET
Description:
Makes the item, room, whatever capable of offering a quest to the player who triggers it.
The trigger has a default for each object type, but you can set it explicitly with the
TRIGGER argument.  The quest can be made non-optional with the OPTIONAL argument.  The
MESSAGE is shown before the quest is offered. The quest details will be as well, unless the
DETAILS argument is set to false. The quest itself can be specified by name, or you can have
 one generated by the RandomQuests behavior by putting GENERATE: followed by optional quest
parameters. The quest must have an accept script (FUNCTION_PROG CAN_ACCEPT and DO_ACCEPT on
something it loads), and must be running.  On an area, with the ENTER, LEAVE, LOOK, SPEAK,
READ, DEATH, GET, WEAR, WIELD or PUTIN triggers, each player is offered the quest once in
each run of the quest; this is kept in the quest variable OFFERED:PLAYERNAME (QVAR), which a
 saved game keeps.  CoffeeSUD: REOFFER says how often to offer it, on any target: ALWAYS
whenever the trigger comes, ONCE in a run of the quest, or a game time (such as 1 MUDDAY)
after the last offer; without it, an area offers once and the rest whenever their trigger
comes.  The details show the quest's SET REWARDS as Reward:.  A quest offered, or read on a
quest board, is listed by QUESTS OFFERED while the player may still take it, and QUESTS
ACCEPT takes it on.
```

<a id="prop-questitem"></a>

```text
Property   : Prop_QuestItem

(REMOVEON=[WON,FAILED,ABANDONED,EXPIRED,ENDED/ALL/NONE])

Description:
CoffeeSUD: binds the item to a quest.  NODROP, NOSELL and NOGIVE refuse those, with a
message; KEEPONDEATH keeps it with the character when they die.  It goes when the quest
leaves ACTIVE for its holder as REMOVEON says: WON, FAILED, ABANDONED (dropped), EXPIRED, or
 ENDED (the quest stopped); ALL, the default, is any of them, NONE none.  QUESTS [QUEST]
lists what the character carries for it.
```

```text
MPQJOURNAL and a quest's SET OBJECTIVE and SET JOURNAL give, kept in this hidden effect so
```

<a id="prop-rejuvwhen"></a>

## PROP_REJUVWHEN

Source: [arc_properties.ini](../../CoffeeMud/resources/help/arc_properties.ini), line 2441.

```text
Property   : Prop_RejuvWhen
Targets    : MOBs, Items
Parameters : WHEN="[ZAPPER MASK]" (ELSE=WAIT/NEVER/REPLACE:[NAME])
Example    : WHEN="-IF !VAR(* OLDMILL == CLEARED)" ELSE="REPLACE:a settler"
Example    : WHEN="-HOUR +20 +21 +22 +23 +0 +1 +2 +3 +4" ELSE=WAIT
Description:
CoffeeSUD: respawns that follow the story.  When the mob's or item's rejuv would bring it
back, WHEN is checked first: on the mob, as if back in its start room (its hour, season,
room text, and -IF/+IF script conditions), or, for an item, on someone in its room.  If it
fails, ELSE says what happens: WAIT (the default) tries again at the next rejuv, NEVER
leaves it gone, and REPLACE:name puts the catalog's mob or item (or a class) there instead,
for good.
```

<a id="prop-roomforsale"></a>

## PROP_ROOMFORSALE

Source: [arc_properties.ini](../../CoffeeMud/resources/help/arc_properties.ini), line 2843.

```text
Property   : Prop_RoomForSale
Targets    : Room
Parameters : (RENTAL/GRID/ALLOWTHEFT) [PRICE]
Example    : 1000000
Example    : Bob/1000000
Example    : @PROFILE/0
Description:
CoffeeSUD: every character of the player's profile owns what another of them owns, and an
owner of @PROFILE (as @PROFILE/0) is the whole profile, so a world can ship a home that is
already the player's; it is never lost as an owner who does not exist.  PROFILEPROPERTY=true
 in the ini records what the player buys as @PROFILE.  MPGRANT gives a deed from a script.

Makes this room available for purchase by a player.  The room will be automatically listed
in the stock of any ShopKeeper in the SAME AREA who is designated a LandSeller, or any
shopkeeper who has the proper StdTitle item in its selling inventory.  The system will
automatically maintain the integrity of any items left in the room, including restoring them
 on reboot.  After a room is sold, the player need only enter "LOOK ID" to see the rooms ID
for the purposes of identifying his or her lot in the future.  The title received for
purchasing a room may be GIVEn or SELLed to change possession of the property. The word
rental followed by a space may precede the price to make the price of the property be
charged every month automatically out of a Bankers account.  Failure to make rent returns
the property to sellable status.The word ALLOWTHEFT disables robbery law enforcement on the
property.

When property is sold, it will be listed as the owner with a slash and the price.  Entering
this sort of parameter directly is the quick way to give players or clans property.

See also Prop_ReqCapacity for the means to set limits on players building abilities on their
 property.
```

```text
Example    : Midgaard#3001
Example    : LONGLOOK;south
Description:
Allows players looking at the room or exit to actually SEE the room description specified in
 the parameter.  Useful for high-up views of the countryside.  The LONGLOOK parameter makes
it so the room is seen only on Examine/Longlook.  ATTACK makes it so a single ranges attack
can target someone in the room (but, not visa-versa).
The Room ID "OUT" can be used to allow boardable items, such as castles, ships, etc, to view
 the room in which their item object is in.  "DOWNINOUT" can be used by the same boardables
to view the rooms below.
```

<a id="prop-salvageyield"></a>

## PROP_SALVAGEYIELD

Source: [arc_properties.ini](../../CoffeeMud/resources/help/arc_properties.ini), line 2701.

```text
Property   : Prop_SalvageYield
Targets    : Items
Parameters : (SKILL=[SKILL ID],...) YIELD="[THING]:[N](@[PCT]%), ..." (XP=[N])
(DESTROY=false)
Example    : YIELD="brass:4, iron(clockwork):1@25%, catalog:soul gear@5%" XP=20
Description:
CoffeeSUD: what taking the item apart gives, in place of the usual.  SKILL is Scrapping when
 not given, or a crafting skill, for its DISMANTLE (* for any).  YIELD is a comma list (in
quotes when it has spaces): [RESOURCE]:[N] is N units of a resource,
[RESOURCE]([VARIANT]):[N] the resource as a named variant, and catalog:[ITEM NAME]:[N] a
catalog item; @[PCT]% after one is the chance of it.  XP is given on success, and
DESTROY=false leaves the item where it is, with nothing more in it.  With it, Scrapping
takes just that item, whatever its material, enchanted or not.  It works on a catalog entry
too.  Without one, [SKILL] DISMANTLE [ITEM] takes apart an item the skill could make,
carried or in the room, for DISMANTLEPCT (in the ini: 50 when blank, 0 for none) percent of
the materials its recipe uses, times the crafter's proficiency.
```

<a id="prop-skytext"></a>

## PROP_SKYTEXT

Source: [arc_properties.ini](../../CoffeeMud/resources/help/arc_properties.ini), line 953.

```text
Property   : Prop_SkyText
Targets    : Areas, Rooms
Parameters : (DAWN="[TEXT]") (DAY=) (DUSK=) (NIGHT=) (INDAWN=) (INDAY=) (INDUSK=) (INNIGHT=)
 (WEATHER_[STATE]=) (STOP_[STATE]=) (MOON=)
Example    : DAWN="The red sun drags itself over the ash dunes." WEATHER_SNOW="Grey ash
begins to fall."
Example    : DAWN=NONE NIGHT="The glowcaps dim as night falls on the surface far above."

CoffeeSUD: an area's or a room's own lines for the sky.  DAWN, DAY, DUSK and NIGHT are told
under the sky as the time of day changes, INDAWN to INNIGHT indoors; WEATHER_[STATE] (CLEAR,

FOG) is the weather's description, as it starts and as LOOK and WEATHER tell it,
STOP_[STATE] its ending line, MOON TIME's moon line.  Alternatives go between |, one picked
each time; NONE says nothing. A room's own come before its area's, an area's before its
parents'; what none sets comes from the area's climate file (AHELP WEATHERPROFILE), then
resources/lists.ini.
```

<a id="prop-switch"></a>

## PROP_SWITCH

Source: [arc_properties.ini](../../CoffeeMud/resources/help/arc_properties.ini), line 3261.

```text
Property   : Prop_Switch
Targets    : Items, Exits
Parameters : (VERBS="[VERB],[VERB]") (STATES="[STATE],[STATE]"/[N]-[N]) (START=[STATE])
(DESC_[STATE]="[TEXT]") (MSG_[STATE]="[TEXT]") (ACTION_[STATE]="[ACTIONS]") (RESET=[TICKS])
(REQUIRES="[ZAPPER MASK]") (REQMSG="[TEXT]") (ONCE=true)
Example    : STATES="down,up" DESC_up="The lever is up." ACTION_up="door open Gate#3 east"
ACTION_down="door close Gate#3 east" RESET=20
Example    : VERBS=turn STATES=1-8 ACTION_5="signal WORLD vault dial5"
Description:
CoffeeSUD: a lever, button, crank or dial that keeps its state.  One of VERBS (pull, push,
turn, press, flip), with the thing's name, moves it to its next state, before the game's own
 command of that name; "TURN DIAL TO 3" to that state; ACTIVATE and DEACTIVATE to the second
 state and the first.  STATES are words or a range of numbers (a dial); START the first.
DESC_[STATE] is added to LOOK; MSG_[STATE] is what the room sees (<S-NAME> who, <T-NAME>
it); ACTION_[STATE] runs script commands, a semicolon between them and MP left off if you
like (door open Gate#3 east; signal WORLD gate1 up; unhide 'a narrow stair'), for the thing,
 $n who moved it.  RESET goes back to START after that many ticks, running its action.
REQUIRES (or MASK) is who may move it, REQMSG what the others are told; ONCE moves it once.
  SWITCH_PROG [STATE] runs on its scripts and its room's, and SWITCHSTATE() reads it.  The
state is kept in the property's text (STATE=), so saves and world files keep it.
```

<a id="prop-telegraph"></a>

## PROP_TELEGRAPH

Source: [arc_properties.ini](../../CoffeeMud/resources/help/arc_properties.ini), line 3326.

```text
Property   : Prop_Telegraph
Targets    : MOBs
Parameters : (NAME=[NAME]) (TICKS=[N]) (WARNING="[TEXT]") (INTERRUPT=STUN,DAMAGE>[N]%,MOVE)
(AVOID=LEAVE,HIDE,COMMAND:[WORD]) (INTERRUPTMSG="[TEXT]") (ABILITY=[ID] TARGET=[NAME])
Example    : TICKS=2 WARNING="<S-NAME> rears back!" INTERRUPT=STUN,DAMAGE>20%
AVOID=COMMAND:brace
Description:
CoffeeSUD: a mob winding up an attack.  Scripts put it on with MPTELEGRAPH (AHELP
BEHAVIOR_SCRIPTABLE), and a generic ability with a WINDUP does when a monster uses it.
WARNING shows at the start and each tick, and LOOK at the mob tells that it is gathering
power.  A stun, sleep, hold or binding always interrupts it; INTERRUPT adds DAMAGE>N% (that
share of its hit points taken meanwhile) and MOVE (it leaves the room); INTERRUPTMSG is what
 the room sees.  AVOID: those who leave the room are never hit; HIDE spares those hidden,
and COMMAND:word those who type the word (brace, duck...).  A generic ability's WINDUP field
 (ticks; MODIFY ABILITY, or WINDUP= in its XML) and WINDUPMSG (the warning, <T-NAME> its
target) make a monster wind it up first and use it on its target when the time is up.
```

```text
Property   : Prop_TicketTaker
Targets    : Mobs, Items
Parameters : [Cost of boarding]/[Name of ticket item]
Example    : 100
Example    : a red ticket
Description:
This property makes a mob or item the master of a carriage, horse, ship, or other rideable
item.  They will require the payment specified in the parameters before allowing anyone else
 to board.  Non-player mobs will always be allowed to board.  The ticket taker must be
riding either the carriage, or riding a horse pulling it, or actually BE the carriage, or
either be just outside or just inside the ship or caravan type boardable.
CoffeeSUD: also accepts FARE=[price] PARTY=LEADER|EACH PETS=[price per pet] CARGO=[price per
 100 lbs]. LEADER charges once for the nearby party and admits its companions on the same
payment. Disembarking clears the receipt. EACH preserves individual payment. The original
numeric and named-ticket formats still work.
```

<a id="prop-trainer"></a>

## PROP_TRAINER

Source: [arc_properties.ini](../../CoffeeMud/resources/help/arc_properties.ini), line 3358.

```text
Property   : Prop_Trainer
Targets    : MOB
Parameters : (STR=#) (INT=#) (DEX=#) (CHA=#) (CON=#) (WIS=#) (NOTEACH)
Parameters : ((ALL) [CLASSNAME]) (EXPERTISENAMES) (SKILLS)
Example    :
Example    : CON=10
Example    : STR=30 INT=15 DEX=20 CON=0 CHA=0 WIS=0 NOTEACH
Example    : all Fighter all Cleric
Description:
This property makes a mob a suitable target for the TRAIN command for players. With no
parameter, it will set all stats to 25, give them 0 levels in all classes, and give them all
 expertises.  Other parameters may be entered in order to set the stats of the mob to the
specified values.  Any values not given will default to 25.  If you do not want the mob to
also be a trainer, you may include the NOTEACH flag.  Listing one or more class names will
make that trainer have 0 levels in those classes (able to train to it).  Not listing any
will give the mob ALL classes at level 0.  Listing expertise IDs works similarly.
CoffeeSUD: the teacher's rules, in any order among the rest: STUDENTMASK="[ZAPPER MASK]"
(whom it teaches at all; REFUSEMSG="[TEXT]" is what it says to others), SKILLMASK.[ABILITY
ID]="[ZAPPER MASK]" (whom it teaches that skill), PRICE="[N] per level" or PRICE=[N] (money
it takes for each lesson, on top of the usual cost) and HIDDEN=[ID],[ID] (skills it teaches
but leaves off TEACHLIST).  They gate TEACH ME, GAIN, PRACTICE and TRAIN with it, and TRAIN
with no trainer named passes over one who refuses.  TEACHLIST shows a student what this
teacher offers them.
```

<a id="prop-transform"></a>

## PROP_TRANSFORM

Source: [arc_properties.ini](../../CoffeeMud/resources/help/arc_properties.ini), line 3378.

```text
Property   : Prop_Transform
Targets    : Items, MOBs
Parameters : (AFTER=[TICKS]/DAYS=[GAME
DAYS]/WHEN=NIGHT/DAY/DAWN/DUSK/FULLMOON/[SEASON]/"[ZAPPER MASK]")
(START=GET/DROP/WEAR/ALWAYS) (RESET=true) (ONLYIN=ROOM/CONTAINER/CARRIED)
INTO="[ITEM]"/MOB="[MOB]"/SET="NAME=.. DISPLAY=.. DESC=.. PROPS=.." (REVERT=true)
(KEEP=FOLLOW,STATE,TAGS,USES,CONTAINER,WORN) (MSG="[TEXT]")
Example    : DAYS=3 START=GET ONLYIN=CARRIED MOB="a wyrmling" KEEP=FOLLOW MSG="$p cracks
open!"
Example    : WHEN=NIGHT REVERT=true MOB="a stone gargoyle" MSG="$p stirs and spreads its
wings!"
Description:
CoffeeSUD: a thing that changes form.  The time: AFTER ticks or DAYS game days (what is left
 is kept with it), counted once START holds (GET: carried, DROP: lying in a room, WEAR:
worn; ALWAYS by default) and while ONLYIN does; RESET starts again when START no longer
holds.  Or WHEN: a time of day, FULLMOON, a season, or a zapper mask tested on its room.  It
 becomes: INTO, an item (from the catalog, or a class) in its place, MOB, a mob there
(KEEP=FOLLOW: following the one who carried it), or SET, changed in place (PROPS adds
properties).  KEEP is also MPTRANSFORM's (STATE, TAGS, USES, CONTAINER, WORN).  With WHEN,
REVERT=true changes it back when WHEN ends.  MSG is shown ($p is what it became).  What it
becomes may have a Prop_Transform of its own.
```

<a id="prop-weaponimmunity"></a>

## PROP_WEAPONIMMUNITY

Source: [arc_properties.ini](../../CoffeeMud/resources/help/arc_properties.ini), line 3630.

```text
Property   : Prop_WeaponImmunity
Targets    : Items, Mobs
Parameters : List of immunities
Example    : +ALL -SILVER -CLOTH -LEATHER
Example    : +ALL -MAGIC -SLASHING -FROSTING
Example    : +ALL -LEVEL15
Example    : +BASHING +IRON +STEEL +MAGIC
Example    : +ALL +MAGICSKILLS +AXE +THROWN +DAGGER
Description:
Whenever the item with this property is worn, or for the mob with this property, they will
attain damage immunities to the types and/or materials of weapons specified.  Here are the
parameters:
+ALL - Specifies that, by default, the mob is immune to ALL damage.
-DAMAGETYPE- Creates an exception to the +ALL rule by permitting damage of the given type.
Examples for DAMAGETYPE would be -PIERCING, -GASSING, -SLASHING, -BURNING, -MELTING,
-NATURAL, -BASHING, etc.
+DAMAGETYPE- Can be used instead of +ALL to create an immunity to the given damage type.
Examples for DAMAGETYPE would be +PIERCING, +GASSING, -WEAPONCLASS- Creates an exception to
the +ALL rule by permitting damage of the given type.  Examples for WEAPONCLASS would be
-AXE, -BLUNT, -EDGED, -FLAILED, -HAMMER, -KARATE, -POLEARM, -RANGED, -SWORD, -DAGGER,
-STAFF, -THROWN, etc.
+WEAPONCLASS- Can be used instead of +ALL to create an immunity to the given of the given
type.  Examples for WEAPONCLASS would be +AXE, +BLUNT, +EDGED, +FLAILED, +HAMMER, +KARATE,
+POLEARM, +RANGED, +SWORD, +DAGGER, +STAFF, +THROWN, etc.
-MAGIC - Creates an exception to the +ALL rule by permitting damage from magical spells and
magical weapons.
+MAGIC - If +ALL is not used, this will create an immunity to magical spells and weapons.
-MAGICSKILLS - Creates an exception to the +ALL rule by permitting damage from magical
spells, chants, songs, or prayers.
+MAGICSKILLS - If +ALL is not used, this will create an immunity to magical spells, chants,
songs, and prayers.
-LEVELX - Creates an exception to the +ALL rule by permitting damage from weapons whose
level is X or better. Example: -LEVEL1, -LEVEL5, -LEVEL10, etc.
+LEVELX - Can be used instead of +ALL to create an immunity to weapons whose level is X or
lower. Example: +LEVEL1, +LEVEL5, +LEVEL10, etc.
-MATERIALTYPE - Creates an exception to the +ALL rule above by permitting damage from a
weapon made of the given MATERIALTYPE.  Where MATERIALTYPE may be any valid material, such
as SILVER, WOOD, COTTON, etc.  As for the damage types above, +MATERIALTYPE may be used
instead of +ALL to create an immunity to a given material.
-PARALYSIS - Creates an exception to the +All rule by permitting damage from paralysis
spells.
+PARALYSIS - If +All is not used, this creates an immunity to damage from paralysis spells.
-FIRE - Creates an exception to the +All rule by permitting damage from fire spells.
+FIRE - If +All is not used, this creates an immunity to damage from fire spells.
-COLD - Creates an exception to the +All rule by permitting damage from cold spells.
+COLD - If +All is not used, this creates an immunity to damage from cold spells.
-WATER - Creates an exception to the +All rule by permitting damage from water spells.
+WATER - If +All is not used, this creates an immunity to damage from water spells.
-GAS - Creates an exception to the +All rule by permitting damage from gas spells.
+GAS - If +All is not used, this creates an immunity to damage from gas spells.
-MIND - Creates an exception to the +All rule by permitting damage from mind spells.
+MIND - If +All is not used, this creates an immunity to damage from mind spells.
-JUSTICE - Creates an exception to the +All rule by permitting damage from justice spells.
+JUSTICE - If +All is not used, this creates an immunity to damage from justice spells.
-ACID - Creates an exception to the +All rule by permitting damage from acid spells.
+ACID - If +All is not used, this creates an immunity to damage from acid spells.
-ELECTRICITY - Creates an exception to the +All rule by permitting damage from electric
spells.

-POISON - Creates an exception to the +All rule by permitting damage from poison spells.
+POISON - If +All is not used, this creates an immunity to damage from poison spells.
-UNDEAD - Creates an exception to the +All rule by permitting damage from undead spells.
```
